title: ep.value_string
description: Enriched `value` string and `aggregation_type` label for a billable metric and the event properties (EP-F1, EP-F2, EP-F4). Type code 0 (`count`): `value` is "1" whatever the properties. Any other code (including the retired 4, unknown codes and 7 `custom`): the text of `properties[field_name]`, one literal key (a dotted name is not a path). Reference text: strings verbatim, numbers as binary64 shortest digits in exponent form `d.ddde±XX` (at least two exponent digits) when the decimal exponent is below -4 or at least 6, booleans `true`/`false`, objects and arrays in the reference's internal rendering, missing key, null value or null properties `<nil>`. Corrected (RBD-13): integer literals exactly, other numbers as shortest round-trip digits in plain notation, "0" for a missing key or null; booleans, objects and arrays have no corrected contract. Label: 0 count, 1 sum, 2 max, 3 unique_count, 5 weighted_sum, 6 latest, 7 custom, any other code "" (RBD-22). Full table: events-processor-spec reference/value-corpus.md.

x-kit-errors.when: properties_json is not a JSON object or null (EP-C1)

aggregation_type.description: The STORED aggregation type code of the metric, as a decimal string ("1" = sum).

field_name.description: The metric's field name (one literal key, a dotted name is not a path); null or absent = the metric has none, so a non-count metric finds no property (EP-F2 missing-key case).

properties_json.description: Exact JSON text of the event's `properties` (an object, or `null`).
